items.definition:
voter
Each elector has the right to cast one vote.

river mouth where tide meets stream
Many fish species breed in the calm waters of the estuary.

aspect, side
The problem has many facets that need to be considered.

short-lived trend
Online challenges often become a temporary fad among teenagers.

part of a scene nearest the viewer
In the painting, a small boat is visible in the foreground.

area between abdomen and thigh
The athlete pulled a muscle in his groin during the race.

explosive mixture
Gunpowder was invented in China centuries ago.

great bravery
His act of heroism saved many lives during the fire.

unfaithfulness to a spouse or partner
The infidelity caused a lot of pain in their relationship.

a special skill or aptitude
She has a knack for making people feel comfortable.

the angular distance of a place east or west of the Greenwich meridian
Navigators use both latitude and longitude to pinpoint locations.

sphere; globe
The magician held a glowing orb in his hand.

a period when a power supply or service is not available
The power outage lasted for several hours.

a small, rounded, compressed mass of a substance
The bird ate the small food pellets.

the large bony frame forming the lower part of the trunk
The doctor examined the patient's pelvis.

a missile that is projected
The cannon fired a heavy projectile.

a platform for loading and unloading ships
The ship docked at the quay.

a person who accepts and deals with a situation as it is
She's a realist and always sees things as they truly are.

the quality of being rich or abundant
The richness of the soil allowed the plants to thrive.

an acute contagious viral disease
Smallpox was a devastating disease before its eradication.

a social organization for female students
She joined a sorority in her first year of college.

a reproductive cell
Fungi reproduce by releasing spores.

a spacecraft designed for interstellar travel
The crew boarded the starship for their long journey.

a person skilled in planning strategy
He is a brilliant military strategist.

a person who tries to be like someone else
He's just a rock star wannabe.

illegal or dishonest behavior
The company admitted no wrongdoing.

a person who treats another person or animal with cruelty or violence
The abuser was arrested for domestic violence.

a former student of a school, college, or university
She is an alum of Harvard University.

a medicine taken or given to counteract a particular poison
There is no known antidote for that poison.

the sport of shooting with a bow and arrow
She practices archery every weekend.

the quality of being pleasing or appealing
Her natural attractiveness was undeniable.

a strong dislike or disinclination
She has a strong aversion to spiders.

a fragrant ointment or preparation used to heal or soothe
The soothing balm helped relieve her dry skin.

chemotherapy (informal)
She's undergoing chemo for her cancer treatment.

a person who plays cricket
The young cricketer scored a century in his debut match.

the action of modifying something to suit a particular individual or task
The software allows for extensive customization of the user interface.

an evergreen coniferous tree
A tall cypress tree stood by the entrance to the garden.

Islamic festival
Muslims celebrate Eid al-Fitr at the end of Ramadan.

act of leaving one's country
The country has seen a high rate of emigration in recent years.

woman engaged to be married
He introduced his fiancée to his parents last night.

chemical compound used in toothpaste
Many toothpastes contain fluoride to prevent cavities.

fraternity
He joined a frat in his first year of college.

genetically modified organism
There is a debate about the safety of GMO foods.

central region of a country
The Midwest is often considered the heartland of America.

state of altered consciousness
She underwent hypnosis to help her quit smoking.

intensive care unit
The patient was transferred to the ICU after surgery.

lack of consistency
There were several inconsistencies in his story.

conclusion reached on the basis of evidence
We can draw an inference from the data.

a left-handed person; a person with left-wing political views
My brother is a lefty, so he writes with his left hand.

A salt or ester of nitric acid.
Nitrates are often used as fertilizers in agriculture.

The financial result of an investment or activity.
All the hard work finally led to a big payoff.

A person who acts as an agent for the sale and purchase of buildings and land.
We hired a realtor to help us find a new house.

A disordered or confused situation.
The players formed a scrum to restart the game.

A squalid and overcrowded urban street or district inhabited by very poor people.
Many people live in the slums on the outskirts of the city.

a trap for catching animals
The hunter set a snare to catch rabbits.

a piece of turf
We laid new sod in the garden.

a division of a section
Please refer to subsection 3.2 for more details.

a newspaper with a compact format
The tabloid often publishes sensational stories.

a person or thing that is similar to an earlier type
His style is a throwback to the 1980s.

an athletic contest consisting of three different events
He trained for months to compete in the triathlon.

a group of dancers, actors, or other performers
The circus troupe performed amazing acrobatics.

an online seminar
I attended a very informative webinar on digital marketing.

a positive statement or declaration
She sought affirmation from her peers.

a rounded swelling or protuberance
There was a suspicious bulge in his pocket.
